# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A pixel-art styled Pomodoro timer built with only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No external dependencies, network requests, or build steps required.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Start/Pause toggle and Reset button
- Large, readable countdown display
- Automatic transition between work and break when timer ends
- Keyboard-accessible buttons with visible focus, hover, and pressed states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Cohesive pixel-art palette with blocky borders and stepped shadows

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the buttons to start, pause, reset, or switch modes. The timer automatically switches between work and break sessions when it reaches zero.

## File Structure

- `index.html` – main page markup
- `styles.css` – pixel-art styling and responsive layout
- `app.js` – timer logic and event listeners

## Notes

All controls are wired with `addEventListener`; no inline event handlers are used. The app works fully offline.
